class.name: arts_controllers/CartesianServoController
class.description: Chainable Cartesian servo controller for a single 6-DoF arm. Takes a target pose, applies a tool-space speed limit, solves damped-least-squares IK with pinocchio, smooths the result in joint space with Ruckig, and writes joint position commands. Carries a live tool-tip offset inside the kinematic model so the Jacobian is computed to the real tip.
